Environmental Education Worldwide

Teaching children to care for their world

Happy Green World Foundation creates localised environmental education for children aged 6–16 — teaching waste, water, and energy literacy through 42 partners in 26 countries across 4 continents.

Our Programmes

Three core curriculum areas, each designed to be localised for the community where it is taught.

Waste & Recycling

Teaching children how to reduce, reuse, and take responsibility for the waste they create — from plastic soup to composting.

Ages 6–16 7 Activity Modules
Learn more

Water & Conservation

Helping children understand where water comes from, why it's precious, and how to protect it in their community.

Ages 6–16 Activities & Guides
Learn more

Energy & Climate

Empowering older students to understand energy systems, climate change, and the everyday choices that shape our future.

Coming Soon •••
Ages 8–16 🔜 Coming Soon
Learn more

"If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together."

— The guiding principle behind Happy Green World

We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors — we borrow it from our children. Happy Green World exists to ensure the next generation receives the knowledge and tools to be responsible stewards of the world they will inherit.
